# What does one rental boat really earn in a short season?

> Find out what a rental boat really earns after fuel, dock, insurance, a short season and weather cancellations, and whether a marketplace listing or a captained charter pays it better.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/boat-rental-fleet-profit-calculator/)
